confidence: high for geometry; model is a single predicted conformation

key_finding: Ser195 0/8, Gly193 0/8, Ser214 0/8, Gly226 0/8 retained; position 189 takes 5 different residues (Q,R,H,L,T), never Asp or Ser; His57 8/8, Asp102 8/8, Cys191 8/8, Asp194 8/8, Gly216 8/8

claim_tested: Conservation of His72/Asp124 implies retained function
key_finding: Buried domain residues (RSA<=0.25, n=128) identity 0.847 vs surface (n=100) 0.705, U=9014, p=2.95e-08. His72 RSA 0.10, Asp124 RSA 0.06. Position 189 equivalent Gln216 RSA 0.52, identity 0.50
confidence: high; burial is a sufficient explanation for dyad conservation

claim_tested: CG34171 retains a binding surface over the former active site

key_finding: Peptidase domain dN/dS 0.094 (vs erecta), 0.106 (vs yakuba), 0.078 (vs ananassae); C-terminal tail 0.81-1.06; ORFs intact in 5 species

context: M. sexta hemolymph, in vitro reconstitution

confidence: high for A. gambiae; CG34171 lacks the clip domain context and the tissue context
